# FROZEN shape of the SIBLING half this rung does not see: an empty collection
# that answers both "nothing was wrong" and "nothing was examined". A caller
# reading `not_judged == []` cannot tell a clean scan from a scan that never
# ran. There is no bound applied here, so no bounded-write rule can reach it.
def judge(paths, read):
    findings = []
    not_judged = []
    for path in paths:
        try:
            findings += read(path)
        except OSError:
            not_judged.append(path)
    return {"findings": findings, "not_judged": not_judged}
